p1.title: Abstention is not a terminal sponsor branch
p1.narrative: The player can stack counsel immediately after abstaining, so abstention has no independent durable consequence, explicit leave-return proof, or branch-legal next action.

p1.title: Counsel lacks decision-legibility context
p1.narrative: The counsel surface omits the evidence, relationship, values, Standing Plan, uncertainty, and public reasons needed for an informed consequential choice.

p1.title: Chronicle links do not restore event time
p1.narrative: Chronicle links expose a raw event identifier and current context; URL reload rejects the event and cannot restore the authoritative event-time world focus.

p1.title: Legacy Founder Alpha product still ships
p1.narrative: The production route graph still exposes /legacy and carries Founder Alpha chunks, contradicting the single Release Genesis product identity and dead-code boundary.
